titulo_ja: しなければ なりません (1)

おきなければ.consejo: It is the form of the form of the form.

しなければ.consejo: It is the form of the form of the form.

のまなければ.consejo: It is the form of the form of the form.

なりません.es: no es posible; no se puede (ser)
なりません.consejo: He goes with the «We have to».

texto: To say «I have to», take the verb in **ない** form, remove the **い** and add **なければ**: **おき** + **なければ** → **おきなければ** (I have to get up).
With **する** it remains **しなければ**, and with **くる** it remains **こなければ**. For the verbs of group 1 the form of the last letter is changed to **あ** (- - - - - - - -).
**〜なければ なりません** and **〜なければ いけません** mean the same thing: **はやく おきなければ なりません** (I have to get up early).
They're educated forms. In informal speech, it says **〜なきゃ**.
